status.statement: DESIGN. These are the approved target values of MASTER CHANGE ORDER V5 (23 Oct 2026). Approval of this policy is not evidence that anything is built, deployed, audited or active: live status comes only from deployment and chain state (master section 16, Configuration acceptance). No v5 value is in force on the live site. In this repository's Worker code, src/maintoken.js reads the amendment-01 helpers (stage S02A) and src/v5policy.js validates the Worker's settings against this policy and, only while the PUBLIC_V5 switch is on and the configuration is accepted, publishes it (stage S07). Owner amendment 01 (24 Oct 2026) replaces the fixed main-token mint with a centrally configured main token: an owner-supplied mint (MAIN_TOKEN_MINT) that is verified on chain before use and stays null until then. The old $VICINITY mint is a legacy token, history only.
status.baseline: live site main 4aa408e; draft program vicinity_curve ec148c2 (not deployed anywhere public)

amendments.source: owner instruction; its verbatim intent is recorded in docs/citycoin-master/amendment-01-new-main-token.md
amendments.summary: A new main token with a new Solana mint, a new official X page and a new official Telegram handle, each supplied by the owner, verified, and configured in one place (MAIN_TOKEN_MINT, OFFICIAL_X_URL, OFFICIAL_TELEGRAM_URL). The old $VICINITY mint becomes a legacy token, history only. No automatic swap, migration, airdrop or transfer of anyone's holdings.
amendments.overrides: master sections 02, 07, 14, 16 and 28 where they keep the existing main-token mint or forbid a replacement main-token mint; for the main token only

main_token.source: owner-supplied, verified on chain before use
main_token.other_token_programs: refused until a reviewed policy change documents and tests them
main_token.until_verified: null everywhere; every feature that needs the main token stays off or hidden
main_token.holder_migration: none: no automatic swap, migration, airdrop or transfer of anyone's holdings

purchase_links.source: the configured, verified main-token mint only
purchase_links.shown_when: a real route exists, checked by a live quote

legacy_tokens.presentation: clearly labeled legacy; no swap or buy offered

official_links.rule: owner-supplied and verified; empty means not shown
official_links.x_url_form: https://x.com/<handle> with a handle of 1 to 15 characters from A-Z, a-z, 0-9 and _; a twitter.com address is accepted and normalized to x.com
official_links.telegram_url_form: https://t.me/<name> with a name of 5 to 32 characters from A-Z, a-z, 0-9 and _

founder_selection.balance_measure: sum of integer base-unit balances over every token account the candidate wallet owns for the configured main-token mint (policy.main_token: MAIN_TOKEN_MINT after on-chain verification; never a legacy mint)
founder_selection.candidates: successfully registered personal wallets assigned to the city before the cutoff, with a strictly positive verified main-token balance and no active account suspension
founder_selection.cutoff: one finalized slot at or immediately before the UTC boundary, with an auditable time-to-slot mapping
founder_selection.snapshot_source: historical indexer or suitable archival RPC; every candidate read at the same cutoff

tie_break.balance_mint: policy.main_token (MAIN_TOKEN_MINT after on-chain verification; never a legacy mint)

country_manager.national_rank_population: all registered personal wallets in the country, not only founders
country_manager.national_rank_balance: current finalized balance of the configured main-token mint (policy.main_token: MAIN_TOKEN_MINT after on-chain verification; never a legacy mint), strictly positive

launch.trigger: one confirmed unique city launch matching the FounderRecord

post.trigger: nonduplicate, visible, non-spam original community post

reply.trigger: visible substantive reply to another member

initiative.trigger: evidence-backed completed initiative, distinct from posts and proposals

proposal.trigger: distinct actionable proposal; no duplicate initiative award

trading.buy_basis: gross quote actually consumed, including the fee
trading.sell_basis: gross quote output before the fee
trading.applies_to: trades through the custom curve and internal pool only
trading.live_status_source: deployment and chain configuration state, never this policy

distribution.holdings_basis: preceding UTC hour's confirmed city-token holdings
distribution.sample_rule: one non-preannounced sample inside each 15-minute segment, plus the cutoff balance
distribution.included_holders: positive-weight personal holders of that city coin
distribution.platform_payout: automatic transfer to the verified configured treasury, per quote
distribution.founder_payout: automatic permissionless fixed-destination transfer to the permanent founder wallet
distribution.liquidity_processing: pregraduation fees stay locked in their bucket; after graduation a trade adds its own liquidity share plus a drip no larger than that share
distribution.failure_isolation: one failed destination, quote or coin never halts the others

buyback.venue: the coin's own curve or internal pool

sol.activation: first production path, after the release gates

usdc.derivation: same city-token allocations and curve shape as SOL; quote parameters scaled from the SOL curve in human units, converted with the quote decimals, then the integer terminal fill solved so that the curve reaches exactly the configured graduation
usdc.activation: only with its own passing evidence

main_token.quote_symbol: main token (symbol read from the verified MAIN_TOKEN_MINT)
main_token.quote_mint_source: policy.main_token (MAIN_TOKEN_MINT), only after on-chain verification and the quote safety checks; never a legacy mint
main_token.derivation: same city-token allocation and curve shape as SOL, with a 1,000,000 main-token-unit graduation and a 1-unit minimum buy; the raw amounts follow from the verified mint's on-chain decimals, so they stay null until the mint is supplied and verified
main_token.activation: only when the configured main-token mint is verified and passes the quote safety checks, and only with its own passing evidence

metadata.pair_selector: changes only the mandatory pair display, from approved quote configs
metadata.approval_publishes: new versioned default: asset and metadata hashes and registry root, then the default updated atomically
metadata.rejection_effect: current defaults stay; the founder may launch with them or submit a corrected request; founder status is unchanged
metadata.ticker_rule: versioned normalization, bounded length, globally unique ticker lock, deterministic collision resolution before publishing
metadata.metadata_uri: permanent citycoin.dev versioned endpoint plus an independent archive for new coins; immutable legacy URIs preserved
metadata.one_launch_per_city: across old and new programs, with permanent city and ticker locks after launch

authorities.user_wallet: login and user-authorized transactions only; no server custody
authorities.selection_signers: constrained selection publisher plus independent verifier; one-time selections only
authorities.keeper: permissionless fixed-destination operations and capped buybacks only
authorities.owner_application_admin: reviews country managers, activity evidence and metadata proposals; publishes approved metadata defaults; no founder selection and no per-launch approval

release_gates.observation_condition: no unresolved critical or high issue
release_gates.legacy_immutable_metadata: exact bytes served as long as existing assets depend on them; never redirected

master_sections_rule: Each string in master_sections names the master section of the value at the same path in policy or deployment. A string at an object's position covers every value inside that object.
